title: fix(plugin-form): a record drawer stays open on its first open (objectui#13238)
body:
Fixes #13238
Clause-②: no

## What was wrong

On the first open of a record drawer in a page session, the drawer disappeared about two seconds after it opened, before its fields loaded. The second open stayed.

I reproduced it live: a Chromium session against a showcase backend (objectstack `9d13b5fc8`, `--fresh`), with this branch's console on the Vite dev server, on `/apps/showcase_app/page/showcase_task_desk`, clicking "Warehouse schema". I added temporary logging to the drawer, the react-page host and the page itself. None of it is committed.

- **No dismiss event closes it.** Radix never called `onEscapeKeyDown`, `onPointerDownOutside` or `onFocusOutside`. The drawer's Sheet `onOpenChange(false)` and `finalizeClose` never ran, and the page's `onOpenChange` was never called. The drawer is **unmounted** instead.
- **What happens, in order:**
  1. The record read ends, and the drawer draws its body for the first time. The field widgets are `React.lazy`, so that render suspends.
  2. `DrawerForm` had no Suspense boundary of its own, so the suspension went to the console route's boundary. The route's loading screen (`data-boot-splash`) was on screen from about +200 ms until the chunks landed, and the whole page was hidden behind it.
  3. When the route came back, React re-ran its effects. `PageView` re-rendered and passed a new page schema object to the `kind:'react'` host. `ReactKindPage` keys its compile on that object's identity, so it recompiled. That remounted the page: the page logged `render editId=null`, and the drawer went with the old page.
- **Why the second open stays:** the widget chunks are cached, so nothing suspends.
- **Why the modal stays:** `ModalForm` already has its own body boundary (objectui#12559).
- **StrictMode matters.** The effect re-run in step 3 is what React does under StrictMode when hidden content comes back, and the console mounts under `React.StrictMode`. I measured the unfixed drawer live with StrictMode removed from the console entry, as a temporary edit that is now restored. The first open then stayed open, but the route's loading screen still covered the whole page for the length of the load. So outside StrictMode the visible defect is the page-wide loading screen. The self-close needs the StrictMode effect re-run.

## The fix

`DrawerForm` now waits for its own body. It wraps the body in a Suspense boundary whose fallback is a skeleton (`DrawerFormBodyPending`), the same shape as `ModalForm`'s `ModalFormBodyPending`. The suspension stays inside the sheet, and the route never shows its fallback. The header stays on screen, and the sheet keeps focus until the first field lands (`useInitialFieldFocus`, objectui#13219). Nothing about dismissal changed: Escape, the Close button and a click on the overlay still close the drawer through `onOpenChange(false)`.

Live, with the fix (same steps):
- **First open:** the loading screen never appears. The drawer is open at every reading from +200 ms to +7000 ms, and focus is on the first field from about +1.5 s.
- **Second open:** the same.
- **Closing:** Escape, the Close button and a click outside each close it through the page's `onOpenChange(false)`.

## Tests

`packages/plugin-form/src/__tests__/drawerFirstOpenStays-13238.test.tsx` mounts a host shaped like the console, under `React.StrictMode`:
- a route boundary whose fallback counts its mounts;
- a route that re-renders when its effects re-run and remounts its page on that render;
- a page that opens `ObjectForm` as a drawer on a row click.

The `url` widget's chunk is held until the test releases it. The file has five cases:
- (a) The first open waits inside the sheet, stays open past the load, the page is not remounted, the route fallback never mounts, the drawer never asks to close, and focus ends on the first field.
- (b) Escape closes it.
- (b) The Close button closes it.
- (b) A click on the overlay closes it. I measured this live first: it is today's behaviour.
- (c) Control: a second open stays open on its first field.

**Ablation**, at `b452ad4310`. `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` from objectstack replaced the boundary with a fragment:
- **Mutation landed:** anchor 1 -> 0, blob `56fbb3c4543d` -> `2ff6fbc5f782`.
- **Result: 5/5 red.** (a) fails on the measured chain:
  - "the drawer is still open past the load: expected null";
  - "the page is the one that opened the drawer (not remounted)";
  - "route fallback mounts while the body loaded: expected 1 to be +0";
  - "the body waited inside the sheet: expected false".
- **Not in that list:** "the drawer never asked to close" did not fail. That matches the live reading that no dismiss event runs.
- **Why (b) and (c) also go red:** each first opens the drawer past its first load.
- **Restore:** blob after restore equals HEAD (`56fbb3c4543d`), and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
- **One no-op attempt:** my first ablation attempt used a replacement text that already occurred in the file. The tool refused it before running anything.

## Gates

All gates ran at `b452ad4310`. Every one exited 0.

- **Targeted vitest** (`--maxWorkers=1`, one package at a time, under the lock), covering this file and every test file that names `DrawerForm`:
  - plugin-form: 41 files, 927 tests
  - plugin-view: 2 files
  - types: 2 files
  - plugin-designer: 2 files
  - app-shell: `PageView.test.tsx`
  - console: `registry-inputs-spec-parity.test.ts`
- **Full directories declared to CI:** `packages/plugin-form`, `packages/plugin-view`, `packages/types`, `packages/plugin-designer`, `packages/app-shell` and `apps/console`.
- **Type-check:** `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-form run type-check`, after a dependency-closure build. Its `tsconfig.test.json` includes the test files.
- **Lint, narrowed to the 2 changed source files:** `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` read 2 files, with 0 errors. All 21 warnings are on lines this PR does not touch. Type-aware linting is not configured (`eslint.config.js` sets no `project` or `projectService`), so this diff cannot change lint results for any other file.
- **Repo checks:**
  - `check:phantom-deps`, `check:self-import`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:doc-example-readers`, `check:handler-key-reads`, `check:side-effects-array`
  - `check:element-data-source-declaration`, `check:spec-symbols`, `check:action-forward-parity`, `check:designer-field-key-parity`, `check:icon-record-names`
  - `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:i18n-designer-parity`, `check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations`
  - `check-hand-rolled-comment-mask`, `check-changeset-fixed`, `check-changeset-presence`

Changeset: `.changeset/13238-drawer-self-close.md` (`@object-ui/plugin-form` patch). Nothing is added to the package entry: no new export, prop or type member. No docs change: this restores how the drawer already promised to behave.

## Acceptance notes

- **Out of scope, reported to the seat and not changed here:** a `kind:'react'` page loses all of its own state whenever `PageView` re-renders. `PageView` passes a new spread of the page to `SchemaRenderer` on every render, and `ReactKindPage`'s scope memo depends on that schema's identity, so `ReactRunner` recompiles and remounts the page. This drawer exposed it through the StrictMode effect re-run. I did not measure which other `PageView` re-renders reach it.
- The card's reading of "the same `h1` before and after" does not prove the page survived. `document.querySelector('h1')` can return an `h1` in the console shell rather than the page's own. The page's own logs show it was remounted.
